title: Wikidata grounding: the 75 topic entries (schools, fields, traditions and debates)
method: Every entry whose entry_kind is "group" in historiography-1920-2000.json has one row. Candidates were found only with the WikidataMCP semantic search (search_items), never the REST name search, using the entry’s label, description and scope_note to phrase the query. Each candidate’s class was then checked with a SPARQL query over P31/P279 and accepted only where the class is an academic discipline, field of study, school of thought, branch of history or comparable concept. No entry is mapped to a person or to a book. Where an entry fuses two or more things and no single item covers it, the row is unmatched and the partial candidates are named in the notes. Wikidata content is CC0.

status_values.unmatched: no item found, or only a narrower or partial item that would misdescribe the entry
status_values.conflict: candidates disagree; needs a human decision

match_kinds.same_concept: the Wikidata item is the school, field or tradition itself
match_kinds.broader_concept: only a wider item exists; the notes say what the entry covers that the item does not
